github-explicit-fields.strategy: fc.record({ gh: fc.string(), path: fc.string(), ref: fc.string() })

github-precedence-over-gist.strategy: fc.record({ gh: fc.string(), path: fc.string(), ref: fc.string(), gist: fc.string() })

no-target-and-no-base.body:
const params = new URLSearchParams([['unrelated', value]]);
expect(diffRefsFrom(params)).toEqual({ target: '', base: '' });

base-and-target-available.strategy: fc.record({baseId: fc.string(), targetId: fc.string(), baseRef: fc.string(), targetRef: fc.string()})

inline-value-precedence.strategy: fc.record({ inline: fc.integer().map((n) => btoa(JSON.stringify({ version: n }))), remote: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: null }) })

remote-fetch-failure.strategy: fc.record({ url: fc.string(), status: fc.oneof(fc.integer({ min: 100, max: 199 }), fc.integer({ min: 300, max: 599 })) })

remote-success.strategy: fc.record({ url: fc.string(), status: fc.integer({ min: 200, max: 299 }) })

valid-inline-base64.strategy: fc.record({ id: fc.stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$/), schemaVersion: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 1000 }) }).map((diagram) => btoa(JSON.stringify(diagram)))

base-gh-present.strategy: fc.record({ gh: fc.string(), path: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }), ref: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }) })

modifiers-without-github-source.strategy: fc.record({ path: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }), ref: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }) })

mixed-edit-entries.strategy: fc.record({node: fc.string(), edge: fc.string(), group: fc.string()})

helpers.makeAnnotationChange: const makeAnnotationChange = (id: string): AnnotationStyleChange => create(AnnotationStyleChangeSchema, {annotationId: id});
helpers.makeDiagram: const makeDiagram = (nodeIds: string[], edgeIds: string[], groupIds: string[]): Diagram => create(DiagramSchema, {graph: create(GraphSchema, {nodes: Object.fromEntries(nodeIds.map((id: string): [string, Node] => [id, create(NodeSchema, {id})])), edges: Object.fromEntries(edgeIds.map((id: string): [string, Edge] => [id, create(EdgeSchema, {id})])), groups: Object.fromEntries(groupIds.map((id: string): [string, Group] => [id, create(GroupSchema, {id})]))})});
helpers.makeEdgeChange: const makeEdgeChange = (id: string): EdgeStyleChange => create(EdgeStyleChangeSchema, {edgeId: id});
helpers.makeEdit: const makeEdit = (nodeChanges: NodeStyleChange[], edgeChanges: EdgeStyleChange[], groupChanges: GroupStyleChange[], annotationChanges: AnnotationStyleChange[]): StyleEdit => create(StyleEditSchema, {nodeChanges, edgeChanges, groupChanges, annotationChanges});
helpers.makeGroupChange: const makeGroupChange = (id: string): GroupStyleChange => create(GroupStyleChangeSchema, {groupId: id});
helpers.makeNodeChange: const makeNodeChange = (id: string): NodeStyleChange => create(NodeStyleChangeSchema, {nodeId: id});
